Mindtickle is the leading AI-powered revenue enablement platform that combines on-the-job learning and deal execution to drive behavior change and get more revenue per rep. Job Snapshot

As a Design Engineer at Mindtickle, you are someone who moves fluently between design and code, brings design intent to life with precision, and raises the bar for what "shipped" looks like. Youll co-own our design system in code, prototype ideas before theyre fully specced, and be the connective tissue between design thinking and production reality.

This is a new role: part interaction designer, part product builder, part systems thinker, part hacker, part artist. If this is you, continue reading!

Key Responsibilities
  • Build high-fidelity interactive prototypes that go beyond what design tools alone can express: motion, data states, edge cases for both web and mobile.
  • Use AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, v0) to accelerate prototype velocity without sacrificing quality or craft
  • Own and evolve Mindtickles UI component library and maintain tight parity between Figma components and production-quality front-end code
  • Define and govern design tokens, theming, and accessibility standards across the design system
  • Participate in design reviews and provide implementation-aware feedback early in the process
  • Explore emerging UI patterns, trends and AI-native UX paradigms, so you keep yourself and the design team up to date.
  • Create POC s that push whats possible in our product experience. Show the art of the possible and challenge our teams.
  • Raise the design teams technical capabilities and understanding by sharing learnings and building a culture of craft.
What we are looking for

  • 8 10+ years working at the intersection of design and frontend engineering. Your portfolio must show both sides of the craft.

  • Production-level proficiency in React, TypeScript, and CSS. You can write code that ships, but you can also whip up a quick experiment or demo.

  • Deep Figma fluency: component architecture, variables, auto-layout, Dev Mode. The whole thing.

  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining a design system in a product company

  • Strong command of motion, micro-interactions, and visual polish. You notice things others miss and know how to add delight to experiences.

  • Comfortable using AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, v0 ) as part of your everyday workflow

  • Solid understanding of accessibility (WCAG), responsive/mobile design, and performance tradeoffs

  • You are a UI artist who thinks like a designer and builds like an engineer

  • Clear communicator who can articulate design and technical tradeoffs to various audiences

What we offer

  • Real ownership of the design system end-to-end, with influence over how design and engineering collaborate

  • AI-native culture with space to experiment and shape how we use these tools well.

  • 24 Design colleagues, in Product Design, UX Research & Content Design.

  • Work on a high-impact product used daily by thousands of sales teams at enterprise-level companies around the world.

  • MacBook Pro and tools, subscriptions & tokens you need to get the job done.

  • Competitive compensation & benefits.

As an organization, it s our priority to create a highly engaging and rewarding workplace. We offer tons of awesome perks and many opportunities for growth.

About PeopleGrove
PeopleGrove is a B2B SaaS company focused on higher education alumni engagement and career outcomes. We partner with colleges and universities to help their communities connect, grow, and thrive through two product lines: CORE (ELMS, CompMS, MyCred, Readiness, Recruit) and HUBS (Engagement Hub, Experience Hub, PathwayU). Were a remote-first team that moves fast, builds with purpose, and cares deeply about the institutions and students we serve.
The Opportunity
Were building a Product Operations function from the ground up, and this is the person who builds it.
PeopleGrove is at an inflection point. Our product and engineering teams are executing well, but the operating system that connects what we build to the rest of the company Sales, Customer Success, Support, and Marketing needs an owner. Release process, internal readiness, cross-functional coordination, and data hygiene are all areas where we know we can do better, and where doing better will directly accelerate growth.
This role reports directly to the VP of Product and has cross-company scope from day one. You wont be maintaining a process someone else built youll be designing and enforcing it.
Why This Role, Why Now
Release process dysfunction is one of the most visible and solvable problems on our roadmap right now. The person who fixes it will have direct, measurable impact on Sales trust, CS readiness, and product team effectiveness and will help build a function that scales with the company. This is a high-visibility role at a company thats growing intentionally and investing in the infrastructure to do it well.
What Youll Own
Release Process Internal Readiness
  • Own the end-to-end release process: calendar, release notes, stakeholder communications, and enforcement.
  • Ensure every release is accompanied by internal readiness across CS, Support, and Sales before anything ships
  • Define and hold the standard for what "ready to release" means at PeopleGrove, and build scalable processes from the ground up to support that. You are not just maintaining quality, you are defining it.
    • This includes but is not limited to:
  • Coordinating and running a monthly New Next meeting to review new and upcoming releases
  • Managing bi-weekly product releases, including attending bi-weekly release lock in and communicating upcoming releases to stakeholders
  • Coordinating release notes production across product managers and ensuring consistent quality
    • Cross-Functional GTM Coordination
  • Serve as the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, Support, and Marketing for every release cycle
  • Partner closely with the AVP of Product Marketing and Solutions Engineer on internal-to-external handoffs
  • Own cross-functional working rhythms: release meetings, RACI maintenance, and process documentation
    • This includes but is not limited to:
  • Managing GTM logistics, including attending cross-functional working groups pre-launch for large releases
  • Defining set of GTM materials based on release tier, and ensuring execution across team
    • Product Team Operating Rhythms
  • Establish and maintain the processes, templates, and tools that help the product team operate consistently and at high quality
  • Own Jira hygiene, sprint health, and reporting cadence.
  • Support quarterly planning rhythms and cross-team alignment rituals
    • This includes but is not limited to:
  • Maintaining jira roadmap boards, catching outdated or inconsistent tickets, and tracking progress toward goals
  • Identify and escalate at risk and missed deadlines
  • Plan, schedule, and run quarterly roadmap planning sessions
    • Data Hygiene Reporting
  • Build and maintain the data and reporting infrastructure that gives the product team clear signal on product quality, delivery, and outcomes
  • Define and track key product health metrics in partnership with Engineering and Analytics
    • This includes but is not limited to:
  • Review Mixpanel events and implement consistent naming conventions and standardize prompts for querying data
  • Set up and report out on data dashboards for product KPIs and goals
    • What Were Looking For
    Must-haves
  • 5 8+ years of experience in product operations, program management, or a senior product role at a B2B SaaS company
  • Has built or significantly improved a release process in a cross-functional environment knows what "good" looks like and how to get there
  • Comfortable holding people accountable across teams without being adversarial can follow up, push back, and enforce standards while keeping relationships intact
  • Strong working knowledge of standard B2B SaaS tools: Jira, Confluence, and similar
  • Finds genuine satisfaction in making systems work well not looking to own a product roadmap, but to make the whole team more effective
    • Strong differentiators
  • Experience standing up a Product Ops function from scratch
  • Has operated at or alongside Director level with cross-company scope
  • Familiarity with higher education, edtech, or similarly mission-driven SaaS environments
    • What This Is Not
    This is not a coordinator role. Its not a project manager role. Its not a support function for a single product team. This person will walk into any team in the company, represent products operating standards, and be taken seriously. They need to have done this before or something close enough that the ramp is short.

  • Work with platform engineering teams to harden vector databases, retrieval APIs, and other AI-serving infrastructure.

  • Strong experience with enterprise monitoring platforms like SolarWinds
  • Proficiency in bash scripting and Linux system administration (RHEL/CentOS/Ubuntu preferred)
  • Experience with event-driven architectures and Apache Kafka for real-time data processing
  • Knowledge of monitoring and observability across Linux systems, storage infrastructure, applications, and network platforms
  • Understanding of metrics collection, time-series data management, and data-driven decision-making
  • Experience implementing AI/ML-based monitoring solutions or anomaly detection systems
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work effectively in fast-paced, complex environments
  • Excellent communication skills with ability to present technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools (Terraform, Ansible, etc.)

As Manager, Engineering, Nonlinear Productivity (Friction Elimination Solutions), you ll help GitLab break the linear relationship between headcount and engineering output. This role exists to be that person the operating discipline behind an ambitious, fast-moving brand strategy, translating it into tracked, on-time, accountable execution across a wide network of external partners and a small internal team. 3. Why This Role Matters Every campaign that ships late, every agency deliverable that misses the brief, and every metric that isnt tracked is a gap between what the brand strategy promises and what actually happens in market. With this much riding on external partners, marketing cannot afford to lose that thread. This role is the single point of truth for whats live, whats due and how every agency and initiative is performing protecting the teams credibility with leadership and keeping a growing web of external partners genuinely accountable. 4. Purpose of the Role To convert brand and marketing strategy into tracked, on-time execution owning the campaign calendar in ClickUp, holding every agency partner accountable to performance and budget, keeping the teams OKR rhythm in Keka current in partnership with the Head of Brand Marketing, and preparing the numbers and narratives leadership needs to make decisions. 5. Key Responsibilities Campaign Project Tracking (ClickUp)
  • Own the master campaign and project tracker in ClickUp every brand, digital, PR, content and event initiative logged, timelined and clearly owned
  • Break every campaign down into tasks, owners and dependencies before work begins, and keep the tracker current, not retrospective
  • Run a single intake process for marketing requests from SBUs, sales and HR, so nothing gets actioned outside the tracked system
  • Plan and balance resourcing and capacity across the internal team and agency partners, so no one is silently overloaded
  • Run a consistent status rhythm that surfaces whats on track, at risk or slipping before it becomes a surprise to leadership
Agency Vendor Performance Management
  • Own performance trackers/scorecards for every media, design, creative, PR, content and event agency, and review them on a regular, non-negotiable cadence
  • Own agency retainers and media buying budgets, reallocating spend toward whats performing and flagging waste early
  • Flag underperforming agencies early, with data, and drive corrective action or escalation rather than letting issues quietly persist
  • Act as the final brand-compliance checkpoint on agency deliverables catching off-brand or off-strategy work before it ships
  • Coordinate with finance and legal on agency contracts, SOWs and invoicing schedules, flagging discrepancies early
Data, Reporting Executive Presentations
  • Track and report on marketing and brand metrics consideration, conversion, advocacy across every live campaign and agency relationship
  • Connect campaign data to real decisions conversion rate, CAC, ROAS so budget and priority shifts are based on what the numbers say, not instinct
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports that turn raw campaign and agency data into clear, decision-ready numbers for the Head of Brand Marketing
  • Prepare and review executive-ready presentation decks for the Head of Brand Marketing translating dashboards and campaign/agency data into a clear leadership narrative
  • Maintain a single, current digital asset library so brand assets dont end up scattered across a dozen agency drives
Team Coordination OKR Rhythm
  • Own the operational rhythm and hygiene of OKRs in Keka ensuring every team members goals are logged, updated and visibly on track each cycle
  • Partner with the Head of Brand Marketing, who retains ownership of setting and formally evaluating each team members OKRs in line with how larger organisations typically split this (the direct line manager owns goal-setting and appraisal; this role owns the process, cadence and tracking around it)
  • Hold regular, calm delivery check-ins with each team member tracking progress against their OKRs and gently, consistently nudging accountability, without stepping into a formal appraisal role
  • Flag OKR risks or slippage to the Head of Brand Marketing early, with data, so goal-level conversations happen with full visibility
AI Tech-Enabled Operations
  • Use AI tools to speed up reporting, summarise campaign and agency performance, and remove manual busywork from tracking
  • Continuously look for ways to make ClickUp, Keka and reporting workflows more efficient for the whole team
  • Stay genuinely current on marketing tech and AI tools relevant to project tracking, reporting and content operations
6. Areas of Ownership
  • The single source of truth for every live campaign and project, tracked in ClickUp including a unified intake process and asset library
  • Agency and vendor performance and budgets tracked, reviewed and flagged on a set cadence
  • Brand-compliance sign-off on agency deliverables before they ship
  • The operational rhythm and hygiene of team OKRs in Keka logged, current and tracked with goal-setting and formal evaluation retained by the Head of Brand Marketing
  • Marketing and brand reporting and executive presentation decks used directly by the Head of Brand Marketing
7. First 30 / 60 / 90 Days First 30 Days Learn
  • Meet the Head of Brand Marketing, the internal team and every key agency partner; understand current campaigns, tools, budgets and reporting formats
  • Audit how work currently flows across project tracking, agency briefs, budgets and reporting, and identify the biggest gaps
  • Get every live campaign, budget and agency relationship logged and visible in one place in ClickUp

jobDescription:
Business Performance Analytics Manager
Function: Global Supply Chain
Location: AIN
Role Summary
The Business Performance Analytics Manager leads the Business Performance Analytics team supporting the Global Planning Network and Site Supply Chain organizations. Reporting to the Global Supply Planning Lead, this role is responsible for delivering integrated business intelligence, performance reporting, digital solutions, and advanced analytics that enable business execution and data-driven decision making across the end-to-end supply chain.
The Manager works collaboratively across Supply Planning, Raw Materials Planning, and Site Supply Chain organizations to connect operational, planning, and financial insights into a cohesive view of business performance.
Leading a team of Business Performance Analytics Analysts, the Manager ensures the delivery of standardized, accurate, and timely analytics, enterprise dashboards, KPI scorecards, and executive reporting that provide consistent visibility across the Global Planning Network. Through strong cross-functional partnerships, the role promotes alignment across planning and site supply chain functions, enabling informed decision-making, proactive performance management, and continuous improvement.
The Manager also develops team capability, fosters collaboration across global and site organizations, and drives process standardization, automation, and adoption of modern analytics solutions that improve business performance and operational effectiveness.
Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Collaboration Business Integration
  • Serve as the primary integrator of business performance at AIN across the Global Planning Network and Site Supply Chain organizations, ensuring a unified view of end-to-end supply chain performance.
  • Foster strong partnerships across Supply Planning, Raw Materials Planning, Digital Technology, and Site Supply Chain teams to align performance measures, priorities, and business objectives.
  • Establish common KPI definitions, reporting standards, and governance processes that create consistency and transparency across global planning and site operations.
  • Connect operational, planning, and financial insights into a cohesive business performance narrative that enables informed executive decision-making.
  • Facilitate cross-functional performance reviews that encourage collaboration, identify interdependencies, resolve performance gaps, and drive aligned improvement initiatives across the global network.
  • Promote a "One Supply Chain" mindset by ensuring analytics and performance reporting support enterprise outcomes rather than functional optimization.
Business Performance Analytics
  • Lead the Business Performance Analytics team supporting the Global Planning Network and Site Supply Chain organizations.
  • Define the analytics strategy, operating model, priorities, and roadmap aligned with Global Planning objectives.
  • Establish governance for GSC Planning KPI reporting, performance management, and business analytics.
  • Ensure timely delivery of recurring and ad hoc reporting.
  • Collaborate with Global Planning on translating business strategy into meaningful performance metrics and executive dashboards.
  • Present business insights and recommendations to Planning and Site Supply Chain leadership to support strategic decision-making.
Planning Network Analytics
  • Provide strategic analytics leadership across Supply Planning, Raw Materials Planning, Inventory Planning and Integrated Business Planning processes.
  • Partner with planning leaders to identify trends, risks, constraints, and opportunities that improve planning performance and supply reliability.
Site Supply Chain Analytics
  • Lead analytics supporting manufacturing and site supply chain operations.
  • Ensure consistent reporting and performance visibility across manufacturing sites while driving standardization of metrics and reporting processes.
Digital Analytics Business Intelligence
Lead the design and continuous improvement of enterprise analytics capabilities including:
  • Executive dashboards
  • KPI scorecards
  • Self-service reporting
  • Data visualization
  • Predictive analytics
  • AI-enabled decision support
Collaborate with AIN GSC Digital team in the development and support of reporting platforms including Tableau, Power BI, SAP Analytics Cloud, and other enterprise analytics tools.
Partner with Digital Technology and SAP teams to prioritize enhancements, improve reporting architecture, and increase automation across supply chain processes.
Financial Performance Value Delivery
  • Partner with Finance to improve visibility of supply chain financial performance including:
  • Budget tracking
  • Cost center performance
  • Logistics costs
  • Inventory carrying costs
  • Scrap performance
  • Forecast accuracy
  • Operational cost drivers
Develop analytics that enable proactive financial decision-making and quantify business value delivered through supply chain improvements.
Continuous Improvement Digital Transformation
Lead initiatives that simplify processes, automate reporting, improve data quality, and standardize analytics across the organization.
Champion:
  • Automation
  • AI-enabled analytics
  • Predictive modelling
  • Data governance
  • Process standardization
  • Digital transformation
Drive continuous improvement projects that improve operational efficiency, reporting effectiveness, and business outcomes.
Team Leadership Talent Development
  • Lead and develop the Business Performance Analytics Analyst team.
  • Prioritize and allocate work across the team to meet business commitments.
  • Build collaborative relationships with planning and site supply chain leaders.
  • Ensure consistent KPI definitions, reporting standards, and data quality across supported functions.
  • Facilitate cross-functional performance reviews and support governance forums.
  • Drive continuous improvement, automation, and analytics capability within the team.
  • Coach and develop team members while fostering a collaborative, customer-focused culture.
Basic Qualifications
8-13 years of experience in Supply Chain, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Operations, Finance, Engineering, or related business functions
OR
Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience consistent with Amgen qualification requirements.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience leading or supervising business analytics, business intelligence, supply chain, planning, or operations teams in a complex global organization.
  • Strong knowledge of end-to-end supply chain planning processes, including Supply Planning, Raw Materials Planning, Inventory Planning, Integrated Business Planning (IBP), Manufacturing, Procurement, Logistics, and Site Supply Chain operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to build collaborative relationships and influence cross-functional stakeholders across global and site organizations to achieve shared business objectives.
  • Experience developing enterprise performance dashboards, KPI frameworks, executive reporting, and business performance scorecards.
  • Knowledge of SAP platforms (S/4HANA, ECC, Fiori, IBP) and enterprise reporting and analytics tools such as Tableau, Power BI, SAP Analytics Cloud, BusinessObjects, SQL, Python, or Databricks.
  • Experience leading process improvement, reporting standardization, automation, and digital transformation initiatives that improve business performance and operational effectiveness.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, and master data management principles.
  • Experience partnering with Finance to support business performance reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and operational performance analysis.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex data into meaningful business insights for diverse audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams, develop talent, manage competing priorities, and deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced, matrixed environment.

AI Innovation

  • Ensure responsible AI practices model governance, explainability, auditability, and data privacy

Application Modernization

  • Architect the migration path for existing applications toward modern, API-first, cloud-native alternatives
  • Introduce scalable backend architectures, microservices patterns, and integration layers
  • Establish integration standards across internal systems and third-party platforms
  • Guide the team in adopting modern development practices without disrupting existing operations

Team Enablement

  • Mentor and upskill a team of junior/mid-level developers acting as a technical guide and thought leader
  • Conduct architecture reviews, design sessions, and technical spikes
  • Create reusable frameworks, reference architectures, and documentation to accelerate delivery

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Translate complex technical concepts for non-technical legal and business stakeholders
  • Partner with Legal, MA, VC, and Global Comms teams to gather requirements and shape solutions
  • Present architecture proposals and technology roadmaps to leadership

Qualifications

Must-Have Skills

  • 8 12 years of experience in software, solution, or technical architecture roles
  • Deep expertise in AWS architecture across services such as Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, S3, RDS, Glue, SageMaker, and Bedrock
  • Strong background in modern application architecture microservices, event-driven systems, API-first design, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes)
  • Solid understanding of AI/ML fundamentals model lifecycle, MLOps, data pipelines, and model deployment
  • Practical exposure to Gen AI technologies LLMs, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), prompt engineering, and AI orchestration frameworks (e. g. , LangChain, LlamaIndex)
  • Strong grasp of data architecture structured/unstructured data, data lakes, document stores, vector databases
  • Experience with security, compliance, and access control in enterprise environments critical given the legal and financial context
  • Proficiency in at least one modern programming language (Python, Node. js, Java, etc. )

Good to Have

  • Experience working with or for legal, financial services, or professional services firms
  • Familiarity with legal tech platforms (contract lifecycle management, eDiscovery, document automation)
  • Experience with vector databases and semantic search (e. g. , Pinecone, OpenSearch, pgvector)
  • Background in DevOps/MLOps CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform, CDK)
  • Multi-cloud awareness (Azure, GCP) in addition to primary AWS expertise
  • Knowledge of Microsoft 365 integrations (SharePoint, Teams, Copilot)

Soft Skills That Matter

  • Strong communicator who can engage both developers and C-suite stakeholders with equal confidence
  • Comfortable with ambiguity able to bring structure to loosely defined problems
  • Collaborative and empowering leader who elevates those around them
  • Pragmatic problem-solver who balances architectural ideals with delivery realities

Job Summary

WJCF is an Indian non-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government-owned, high-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across Indias national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments, supporting the Ministry of Health Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions.

As an Indian organisation, WJCF brings an unmatched depth of contextual understanding of Indias health system architecture, policy landscape, and implementation realities across diverse geographies and population groups. This local institutional credibility, combined with global technical rigour, is central to WJCFs effectiveness as a partner to governments and donors.

Our work is built around four complementary roles: as a Trusted Government Partner, co-designing programmes and strengthening health system architecture; as an Operational Partner, translating strategies into effective on-the-ground delivery; as a Market Shaper, improving the availability and affordability of health commodities; and as an Ecosystem Catalyst, convening governments, development partners, academia, and the private sector to drive solutions at scale.

WJCFs programme portfolio spans thematic areas like hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, vector-borne diseases, syphilis, cervical cancer, diabetes, maternal and childhood anaemia, immunisation, under-5 diarrhoea and pneumonia, sexual and reproductive health, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), hypoxemia and oxygen, safe drinking water, sickle cell disease, presbyopia, lead poisoning, and cross-cutting thematic areas like AI and Health, integrated disease surveillance, and climate and health.

We currently support programmes across 19 states and union territories, with teams working at national, state, district, and sub-district levels.

Our people are our greatest asset. WJCF brings together a talented, diverse team of professionals from public health, analytics, consulting, healthcare, the development sector, and academia, all united by a shared commitment to improving health outcomes for the people of India. We are entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country.

WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values.

Project Background:

Over the past seven years, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY) has become one of the largest health-assurance programmes in the world. It has issued more than 44 crore Ayushman cards and authorised over 11.1 crore hospital admissions worth around 1.73 lakh crore, across a network of more than 38,000 empanelled hospitals. Running at this scale, the programme has generated a large volume of data as a by-product of its everyday operations, built up over seven years of registrations, pre-authorisations, claims, and utilisation records. Making sense of data this size has never been easy, but Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) now provide an opportunity to derive meaningful insights from this rich repository of data more systematically, robustly, more quickly and in a manner that is more actionable than previously possible or conceivable. This in turn provides a clearer picture of how the scheme is working, and of the ways in which even further value can be delivered to citizens by the scheme, giving the National Health Authority (NHA) a real opportunity to refine the programme and sharply improve its effectiveness.

The NHA, an attached office of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare with full functional autonomy, implements AB PM-JAY and also drives the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), now a mature layer of national digital health infrastructure that includes registries such as the Health Facility Registry and the Healthcare Professionals Registry and platforms such as the National Health Claims Exchange (NHCX). ABDM follows a federated architecture built on privacy and security by design, which means there is no central store of health records. A patients clinical records stay with the facility that created them and move only as encrypted FHIR bundles, with the patients consent, so the NHA never looks inside an individuals health record. What it can work with is aggregated and metadata-level information, for example how actively facilities and providers are participating, or how registration compares with actual use, and even this is enough to reveal patterns that help strengthen the programme.

Turning this potential into practical insight needs dedicated, specialised capacity. The Health Analytics and AI Unit (HAAU) is the NHAs in-house capability for advanced analytics and AI, set up to do exactly this. WJCF supported the NHA in preparing the HAAU Vision Document and, through a team embedded at the NHA, has helped take it from vision to delivery, producing analyses and tools that are already changing how the NHA uses its data. WJCF is now expanding the HAAU with a set of specialised roles to accelerate delivery and catalyse the development of institutionalised capability within the NHA. All of this work is done with privacy by design and strong data governance, in line with the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act 2023 and the Strategy for Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare for India (SAHI).

Position Summary

WJCF is looking to hire a Health Financing Specialist within the Health Analytics and AI Unit (HAAU), embedded within the NHA and reporting to the HAAU Lead. This role brings dedicated health-financing and health-economics capability to the unit, working across the questions at the core of AB PM-JAY: benefit-package selection, evidence-based package pricing and costing, strategic purchasing and value-based care, and the cost-benefit of beneficiary-inclusion and eligibility decisions. The selected candidate will play a key role in shaping the analytical agenda of the HAAU with a view to firmly establish AB-PMJAY on a path towards financial sustainability while continuing to scale towards Universal Health Coverage. Working as part of one integrated team, the Specialist shapes financing questions into clear hypotheses and requirements, and turns the schemes own claims, utilisation, and cost data into evidence for package design, pricing, and purchasing decisions.

This position is based out of the NHA office in New Delhi, so that the individual stays closely aligned with the NHAs immediate priorities and the rapidly evolving digital health landscape. This role provides an excellent opportunity for a health-financing professional who would like to shape the financial sustainability of Indias flagship health protection programme.

Responsibilities

  • Bring dedicated health-financing and health-economics capability to the HAAU.
  • Work across the questions at the core of AB PM-JAY: such as benefit-package selection, evidence-based package pricing and costing, strategic purchasing and value-based care, and the cost-benefit of beneficiary-inclusion and eligibility decisions.
  • Support the move to claims transparency as AB PM-JAY empanelled hospitals transition to raising claims through the National Health Claims Exchange (NHCX).
  • Turn claims, utilisation, and cost data into evidence for package design, pricing, and purchasing decisions, working closely with the units data-science skills.
  • Design and model financing and purchasing options and quantify their fiscal impact.
  • Produce clear options papers and decision-ready recommendations for senior NHA leadership.
  • Embed privacy-by-design and strong health data governance across the financing work, consistent with the DPDP Act 2023 and SAHI, and perform other responsibilities as requested by WJCF and NHA leadership.

Qualifications

  • Bachelors or masters degree in health economics, economics,
